exposure: History of previous spontaneous vaginal delivery
outcome: Successful vaginal birth after caesarean section (VBAC)
cohort: 305 mothers at public hospitals in Ambo town, Ethiopia, with 74 cases (successful VBAC) and 221 controls (unsuccessful VBAC)
finding: Maternal age less than 30 years, history of previous successful VBAC, history of previous spontaneous vaginal delivery, and cervical dilation ≥4cm at admission were independent determinants of successful VBAC.
